operational_definitions.DEFER: The action is already justified for the represented project plan, a specific currently unresolved supplied prerequisite/trigger must occur first, and the supplied state represents the action as current next work once that trigger is satisfied. A DEFER output must identify that exact trigger in defer_until_id.
operational_definitions.NOT_NOW: The current objective/state does not materially justify prioritizing the action, and no represented supplied trigger establishes that satisfying one current dependency makes the action current next work. A NOT_NOW output must set defer_until_id to null. Do not use DEFER merely because the action might become useful someday.

common_instruction: Classify the one candidate action using only DEFER or NOT_NOW. Use DEFER only when the supplied state explicitly establishes that the action is already part of the represented plan, a specific unresolved supplied trigger must happen first, and satisfying that trigger makes the action current next work. When DEFER, return the exact activating trigger ID in defer_until_id. Use NOT_NOW when the current objective/state does not materially justify the action and no supplied trigger is established to activate it as current next work; in that case defer_until_id must be null. The mere possibility that an action could become useful later is not enough for DEFER. Do not invent project facts or trigger IDs.
user_task: Classify the candidate action for the supplied project state and identify an exact defer trigger only when the operational DEFER definition is satisfied.
